description: This file defines a React component for a login page in a web application. It manages user input for email and password, handles login requests, and includes UI elements for password reset and account creation.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: A React component class that renders a login form with email and password fields, handles user interactions, and manages login state.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Login component with default state and binds event handler methods.

methods.name: onClickLogin
methods.description: Handles the login button click, validates input, and triggers login request.

methods.name: onEmailChanged
methods.description: Updates email state when user types in the email field.

methods.name: onPasswordChanged
methods.description: Updates password state when user types in the password field.

methods.name: isEmailInvalid
methods.description: Determines if the email input is invalid based on current state.

methods.name: isPasswordInvalid
methods.description: Determines if the password input is invalid based on current state.

methods.name: sendLoginRequestIfCredentialsAreValid
methods.description: Checks if credentials are valid and initiates login request.

methods.name: sendLoginRequest
methods.description: Performs the login HTTP request and handles response.

methods.name: renderLoginError
methods.description: Renders an error message if login fails.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the login form UI including input fields, buttons, and modals.
